Aatrox.goal: Reference for Aatrox: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (4,225 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 56.2% win rate).
Aatrox.hypothesis: A spell-driven melee fighter who controls spacing with repeated knockups and sustains through champion damage. Weaving the periodic empowered attack matters alongside landing Q edges. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
